title: 02 — Derive States And Sizes (Atoms)
system_instructions: You are working on step 02 of the Atoms pipeline in @vsk/ui-kit.
Communicate with the human developer/designer in Russian (RU), but keep code identifiers, file paths, shell commands, and other technical literals in English.
Do NOT install or upgrade any packages. Use the workspace stack: Angular ^20.3.x, Storybook ^10.0.6, Taiga 4.16.0.
goal: Produce an authoritative list of visual states and size variants to be demonstrated in stories for a single atom.

roles.agent: Analyze CSS facts and assets to infer states and sizes.
roles.developer: Approve which states and sizes are in scope for the atom.
roles.designer: Confirm that the chosen states and sizes match the design intent.

inputs_expected: Any combined or per-state assets under `projects/.../assets/atoms/<atom-name>/figma/`.

actions.description: Infer states and sizes from CSS facts and assets.
logic: States: look for hover/focus/disabled/active/loading/error/success selectors or annotations.
Sizes: infer from distinct heights/typography and any known size tokens (s/m/l).
human_checklist: Список состояний (states) включает все нужные и только нужные варианты?
Список размеров (sizes) соответствует макетам (s/m/l или иной набор)?
Отмечены ли явно те состояния/размеры, которые агент предложил по умолчанию (inferred), а не нашёл в макете?

acceptance_criteria: Developer/designer have explicitly approved the lists.
Notes mention any intentionally omitted states/sizes.
